STATE
ticket: 5 (BUG `combination_with_replacement_index`, more.py line 4282): in progress; 6 of 8 tests fail (e.g. test_long 0 != 2000000, test_multiplicity 21 != 0, test_r_equal_to_n 20 != 0, test_r_less_than_n 84 != 0, plus ValueError not raised in an invalid-case test); brute force shows even ('a',) on 'abc' gives 1 instead of 0, and ('a','b','c') on 'abc' wrongly raises ValueError (for-else fires when element is fully consumed at the last pool item without `y` becoming None).
ticket 3 (notice): no fix; rule recorded above.
current ticket: 5/44.
combination_index: confirmed broken in /app (returns 15 vs 10 for 'adf'/'abcdefg'; ('a',) in 'abc' → 1 not 0; ('ab','abc') → 2 not 0); comb (from math) and last (line 254) verified correct, so the bug is inside combination_index itself; still not ticketed — do not fix unless a ticket names it.
combination_with_replacement_index: full brute force over 'abc'/'abcd' r=0..n shows every non-trivial case wrong (e.g. ('a',)→1 not 0, ('a','a')→3 not 0, ('a','b')→4 not 1, ('b','b')→0 not 3) plus ValueError on ('a','b','c') in 'abc' (should be 9); root cause: the for-else at line 4317 raises whenever the for loop finishes without `if y is None: break` firing — y only becomes None when next(element) is called inside the `while x != y` loop, so a fully-matched element whose last value equals the last pool item (or is matched without consuming the element) falls into the else; the index math (lines 4327-4334) also produces wrong values in most cases, so the fix likely needs more than the else clause.
OPEN
- Ticket 5 in progress: rewrite/fix `combination_with_replacement_index` (lines 4282-4336) so all 8 tests in CombinationWithReplacementIndexTests pass; every added/changed line needs `  # fixed`; verify with `t CombinationWithReplacementIndexTests`, then `next`.
- Correct reference formula derived: index = sum over pool positions i of C(rem_i - occ[i] + n - i - 2, n - i - 1), rem_i = l - sum_{j<i} occ[j] (verified by hand for (a,b)=1, (a,c)=2, (b,b)=3, (c,c)=5 in 'abc' l=2).
